purpose: Record 2026-dated markers and explicit host stubs inside delivered reference-source fragments. Markers flag a provenance question; they do not by themselves establish a semantic difference from target2016.
verificationRule: For each divergence: the fragment range must be part of the named module originalFunctions in artifacts/native/manifest.json, its SHA256 must match the source lines, and every listed 2026 marker must occur inside those bytes. tests/native/source-tree-divergence.test.mjs recomputes these checks and finds unrecorded 2026-dated lines in line-ranged compiled fragments; extracted hash-only bodies and other years are outside this scan. A sourceRange records the complete original line range when signature-based extraction omits its leading /*virtual*/ annotation and closing-line CRLF after the final brace; both the complete raw range and delivered signature fragment are independently hashed.
sourceTreeNature: The pinned reference tree (.cache/native-source-runtime, commit a8438f3ed18dd6f0944793de6c0d8bb9334e9633) is a 2015-era code line that also carries 2026 revision markers. It is a reference, never the 2016 V6.0420.5 client source.
